diagnosis: Acute leukaemia of ambiguous lineage with other defined genetic alterations
legend: A A representative case of T-myeloid mixed-phenotype acute leukaemia with t(6;14)(q25;q32) (arrows) involving BCL11B. B–D Blasts (red) are positive for CD7, CD13, CD34, and KIT (CD117). A subset of blasts is positive for cCD3 and myeloperoxidase. Normal lymphocytes (blue) in the background are included as controls.
